1609: 		c.maxTime = t
1610: 		return true, chunkCreated

1613: 	if recoded { // The appender needed to recode the chunk.
1614: 		c.maxTime = t
1615: 		c.chunk = newChunk
1616: 		return true, false
1617: 	}
1618: 
1619: 	s.headChunks = &memChunk{
1620: 		chunk:   newChunk,
1621: 		minTime: t,
1622: 		maxTime: t,
1623: 		prev:    s.headChunks,
1624: 	}
1625: 	s.nextAt = rangeForTimestamp(t, o.chunkRange)
1626: 	return true, true

1629: // appendPreprocessor takes care of cutting new XOR chunks and m-mapping old ones. XOR chunks are cut based on the
1630: // number of samples they contain with a soft cap in bytes.
1631: // It is unsafe to call this concurrently with s.iterator(...) without holding the series lock.
1632: // This should be called only when appending data.
1633: func (s *memSeries) appendPreprocessor(t int64, e chunkenc.Encoding, o chunkOpts) (c *memChunk, sampleInOrder, chunkCreated bool) {
1634: 	// We target chunkenc.MaxBytesPerXORChunk as a hard for the size of an XOR chunk. We must determine whether to cut
1635: 	// a new head chunk without knowing the size of the next sample, however, so we assume the next sample will be a
1636: 	// maximally-sized sample (19 bytes).
1637: 	const maxBytesPerXORChunk = chunkenc.MaxBytesPerXORChunk - 19
1638: 
1639: 	c = s.headChunks
1640: 
1641: 	if c == nil {
1642: 		if len(s.mmappedChunks) > 0 && s.mmappedChunks[len(s.mmappedChunks)-1].maxTime >= t {
1643: 			// Out of order sample. Sample timestamp is already in the mmapped chunks, so ignore it.
1644: 			return c, false, false
1645: 		}
1646: 		// There is no head chunk in this series yet, create the first chunk for the sample.
1647: 		c = s.cutNewHeadChunk(t, e, o.chunkRange)
1648: 		chunkCreated = true
1649: 	}
1650: 
1651: 	// Out of order sample.
1652: 	if c.maxTime >= t {
1653: 		return c, false, chunkCreated
1654: 	}
1655: 
1656: 	// Check the chunk size, unless we just created it and if the chunk is too large, cut a new one.
1657: 	if !chunkCreated && len(c.chunk.Bytes()) > maxBytesPerXORChunk {
1658: 		c = s.cutNewHeadChunk(t, e, o.chunkRange)
1659: 		chunkCreated = true
1660: 	}
1661: 
1662: 	if c.chunk.Encoding() != e {
1663: 		// The chunk encoding expected by this append is different than the head chunk's
1664: 		// encoding. So we cut a new chunk with the expected encoding.
1665: 		c = s.cutNewHeadChunk(t, e, o.chunkRange)
1666: 		chunkCreated = true
1667: 	}
1668: 
1669: 	numSamples := c.chunk.NumSamples()
1670: 	if numSamples == 0 {
1671: 		// It could be the new chunk created after reading the chunk snapshot,
1672: 		// hence we fix the minTime of the chunk here.
1673: 		c.minTime = t
1674: 		s.nextAt = rangeForTimestamp(c.minTime, o.chunkRange)
1675: 	}
1676: 
1677: 	// If we reach 25% of a chunk's desired sample count, predict an end time
1678: 	// for this chunk that will try to make samples equally distributed within
1679: 	// the remaining chunks in the current chunk range.
1680: 	// At latest it must happen at the timestamp set when the chunk was cut.
1681: 	if numSamples == o.samplesPerChunk/4 {
1682: 		s.nextAt = computeChunkEndTime(c.minTime, c.maxTime, s.nextAt, 4)
1683: 	}
1684: 	// If numSamples > samplesPerChunk*2 then our previous prediction was invalid,
1685: 	// most likely because samples rate has changed and now they are arriving more frequently.
1686: 	// Since we assume that the rate is higher, we're being conservative and cutting at 2*samplesPerChunk
1687: 	// as we expect more chunks to come.
1688: 	// Note that next chunk will have its nextAt recalculated for the new rate.
1689: 	if t >= s.nextAt || numSamples >= o.samplesPerChunk*2 {
1690: 		c = s.cutNewHeadChunk(t, e, o.chunkRange)
1691: 		chunkCreated = true
1692: 	}
1693: 
1694: 	return c, true, chunkCreated
1695: }

1697: // histogramsAppendPreprocessor takes care of cutting new histogram chunks and m-mapping old ones. Histogram chunks are
1698: // cut based on their size in bytes.
1699: // It is unsafe to call this concurrently with s.iterator(...) without holding the series lock.
1700: // This should be called only when appending data.
1701: func (s *memSeries) histogramsAppendPreprocessor(t int64, e chunkenc.Encoding, o chunkOpts) (c *memChunk, sampleInOrder, chunkCreated bool) {
1702: 	c = s.headChunks
1703: 
1704: 	if c == nil {
1705: 		if len(s.mmappedChunks) > 0 && s.mmappedChunks[len(s.mmappedChunks)-1].maxTime >= t {
1706: 			// Out of order sample. Sample timestamp is already in the mmapped chunks, so ignore it.
1707: 			return c, false, false
1708: 		}
1709: 		// There is no head chunk in this series yet, create the first chunk for the sample.
1710: 		c = s.cutNewHeadChunk(t, e, o.chunkRange)
1711: 		chunkCreated = true
1712: 	}
1713: 
1714: 	// Out of order sample.
1715: 	if c.maxTime >= t {
1716: 		return c, false, chunkCreated
1717: 	}
1718: 
1719: 	if c.chunk.Encoding() != e {
1720: 		// The chunk encoding expected by this append is different than the head chunk's
1721: 		// encoding. So we cut a new chunk with the expected encoding.
1722: 		c = s.cutNewHeadChunk(t, e, o.chunkRange)
1723: 		chunkCreated = true
1724: 	}
1725: 
1726: 	numSamples := c.chunk.NumSamples()
1727: 	targetBytes := chunkenc.TargetBytesPerHistogramChunk
1728: 	numBytes := len(c.chunk.Bytes())
1729: 
1730: 	if numSamples == 0 {
1731: 		// It could be the new chunk created after reading the chunk snapshot,
1732: 		// hence we fix the minTime of the chunk here.
1733: 		c.minTime = t
1734: 		s.nextAt = rangeForTimestamp(c.minTime, o.chunkRange)
1735: 	}
1736: 
1737: 	// Below, we will enforce chunkenc.MinSamplesPerHistogramChunk. There are, however, two cases that supersede it:
1738: 	//  - The current chunk range is ending before chunkenc.MinSamplesPerHistogramChunk will be satisfied.
1739: 	//  - s.nextAt was set while loading a chunk snapshot with the intent that a new chunk be cut on the next append.
1740: 	var nextChunkRangeStart int64
1741: 	if s.histogramChunkHasComputedEndTime {
1742: 		nextChunkRangeStart = rangeForTimestamp(c.minTime, o.chunkRange)
1743: 	} else {
1744: 		// If we haven't yet computed an end time yet, s.nextAt is either set to
1745: 		// rangeForTimestamp(c.minTime, o.chunkRange) or was set while loading a chunk snapshot. Either way, we want to
1746: 		// skip enforcing chunkenc.MinSamplesPerHistogramChunk.
1747: 		nextChunkRangeStart = s.nextAt
1748: 	}
1749: 
1750: 	// If we reach 25% of a chunk's desired maximum size, predict an end time
1751: 	// for this chunk that will try to make samples equally distributed within
1752: 	// the remaining chunks in the current chunk range.
1753: 	// At the latest it must happen at the timestamp set when the chunk was cut.
1754: 	if !s.histogramChunkHasComputedEndTime && numBytes >= targetBytes/4 {
1755: 		ratioToFull := float64(targetBytes) / float64(numBytes)
1756: 		s.nextAt = computeChunkEndTime(c.minTime, c.maxTime, s.nextAt, ratioToFull)
1757: 		s.histogramChunkHasComputedEndTime = true
1758: 	}
1759: 	// If numBytes > targetBytes*2 then our previous prediction was invalid. This could happen if the sample rate has
1760: 	// increased or if the bucket/span count has increased.
1761: 	// Note that next chunk will have its nextAt recalculated for the new rate.
1762: 	if (t >= s.nextAt || numBytes >= targetBytes*2) && (numSamples >= chunkenc.MinSamplesPerHistogramChunk || t >= nextChunkRangeStart) {
1763: 		c = s.cutNewHeadChunk(t, e, o.chunkRange)
1764: 		chunkCreated = true
1765: 	}
1766: 
1767: 	// The new chunk will also need a new computed end time.
1768: 	if chunkCreated {
1769: 		s.histogramChunkHasComputedEndTime = false
1770: 	}
1771: 
1772: 	return c, true, chunkCreated
1773: }
1774: 
1775: // computeChunkEndTime estimates the end timestamp based the beginning of a
1776: // chunk, its current timestamp and the upper bound up to which we insert data.
1777: // It assumes that the time range is 1/ratioToFull full.
1778: // Assuming that the samples will keep arriving at the same rate, it will make the
1779: // remaining n chunks within this chunk range (before max) equally sized.
1780: func computeChunkEndTime(start, cur, maxT int64, ratioToFull float64) int64 {
1781: 	var coordinator headAppender
1782: 	return coordinator.predictChunkEndTime(start, cur, maxT, ratioToFull)
1783: }

1785: func (s *memSeries) cutNewHeadChunk(mint int64, e chunkenc.Encoding, chunkRange int64) *memChunk {
1786: 	// When cutting a new head chunk we create a new memChunk instance with .prev
1787: 	// pointing at the current .headChunks, so it forms a linked list.
1788: 	// All but first headChunks list elements will be m-mapped as soon as possible
1789: 	// so this is a single element list most of the time.
1790: 	s.headChunks = &memChunk{
1791: 		minTime: mint,
1792: 		maxTime: math.MinInt64,
1793: 		prev:    s.headChunks,
1794: 	}
1795: 
1796: 	if chunkenc.IsValidEncoding(e) {
1797: 		var err error
1798: 		s.headChunks.chunk, err = chunkenc.NewEmptyChunk(e)
1799: 		if err != nil {
1800: 			panic(err) // This should never happen.
1801: 		}
1802: 	} else {
1803: 		s.headChunks.chunk = chunkenc.NewXORChunk()
1804: 	}
1805: 
1806: 	// Set upper bound on when the next chunk must be started. An earlier timestamp
1807: 	// may be chosen dynamically at a later point.
1808: 	s.nextAt = rangeForTimestamp(mint, chunkRange)
1809: 
1810: 	app, err := s.headChunks.chunk.Appender()
1811: 	if err != nil {
1812: 		panic(err)
1813: 	}
1814: 	s.app = app
1815: 	return s.headChunks
1816: }

1832: // s must be locked when calling.
1833: func (s *memSeries) mmapCurrentOOOHeadChunk(chunkDiskMapper *chunks.ChunkDiskMapper, logger *slog.Logger) []chunks.ChunkDiskMapperRef {
1834: 	if s.ooo == nil || s.ooo.oooHeadChunk == nil {
1835: 		// OOO is not enabled or there is no head chunk, so nothing to m-map here.
1836: 		return nil
1837: 	}
1838: 	chks, err := s.ooo.oooHeadChunk.chunk.ToEncodedChunks(math.MinInt64, math.MaxInt64)
1839: 	if err != nil {
1840: 		handleChunkWriteError(err)
1841: 		return nil
1842: 	}
1843: 	chunkRefs := make([]chunks.ChunkDiskMapperRef, 0, len(chks))
1844: 	for _, memchunk := range chks {
1845: 		if len(s.ooo.oooMmappedChunks) >= (oooChunkIDMask - 1) {
1846: 			logger.Error("Too many OOO chunks, dropping data", "series", s.lset.String())
1847: 			break
1848: 		}
1849: 		chunkRef := chunkDiskMapper.WriteChunk(s.ref, memchunk.minTime, memchunk.maxTime, memchunk.chunk, true, handleChunkWriteError)
1850: 		chunkRefs = append(chunkRefs, chunkRef)
1851: 		s.ooo.oooMmappedChunks = append(s.ooo.oooMmappedChunks, &mmappedChunk{
1852: 			ref:        chunkRef,
1853: 			numSamples: uint16(memchunk.chunk.NumSamples()),
1854: 			minTime:    memchunk.minTime,
1855: 			maxTime:    memchunk.maxTime,
1856: 		})
1857: 	}
1858: 	s.ooo.oooHeadChunk = nil
1859: 	return chunkRefs
1860: }

1862: // mmapChunks will m-map all but first chunk on s.headChunks list.
1863: func (s *memSeries) mmapChunks(chunkDiskMapper *chunks.ChunkDiskMapper) (count int) {
1864: 	if s.headChunks == nil || s.headChunks.prev == nil {
1865: 		// There is none or only one head chunk, so nothing to m-map here.
1866: 		return
1867: 	}
1868: 
1869: 	// Write chunks starting from the oldest one and stop before we get to current s.headChunks.
1870: 	// If we have this chain: s.headChunks{t4} -> t3 -> t2 -> t1 -> t0
1871: 	// then we need to write chunks t0 to t3, but skip s.headChunks.
1872: 	for i := s.headChunks.len() - 1; i > 0; i-- {
1873: 		chk := s.headChunks.atOffset(i)
1874: 		chunkRef := chunkDiskMapper.WriteChunk(s.ref, chk.minTime, chk.maxTime, chk.chunk, false, handleChunkWriteError)
1875: 		s.mmappedChunks = append(s.mmappedChunks, &mmappedChunk{
1876: 			ref:        chunkRef,
1877: 			numSamples: uint16(chk.chunk.NumSamples()),
1878: 			minTime:    chk.minTime,
1879: 			maxTime:    chk.maxTime,
1880: 		})
1881: 		count++
1882: 	}
1883: 
1884: 	// Once we've written out all chunks except s.headChunks we need to unlink these from s.headChunk.
1885: 	s.headChunks.prev = nil
1886: 
1887: 	return count
1888: }

1896: // Rollback removes the samples and exemplars from headAppender and writes any series to WAL.
1897: func (a *headAppender) Rollback() (err error) {
1898: 	if a.closed {
1899: 		return ErrAppenderClosed
1900: 	}
1901: 	defer func() { a.closed = true }()
1902: 	defer a.head.metrics.activeAppenders.Dec()
1903: 	defer a.head.iso.closeAppend(a.appendID)
1904: 	defer a.head.putSeriesBuffer(a.sampleSeries)
1905: 
1906: 	var series *memSeries
1907: 	for i := range a.samples {
1908: 		series = a.sampleSeries[i]
1909: 		series.Lock()
1910: 		series.cleanupAppendIDsBelow(a.cleanupAppendIDsBelow)
1911: 		series.pendingCommit = false
1912: 		series.Unlock()
1913: 	}
1914: 	for i := range a.histograms {
1915: 		series = a.histogramSeries[i]
1916: 		series.Lock()
1917: 		series.cleanupAppendIDsBelow(a.cleanupAppendIDsBelow)
1918: 		series.pendingCommit = false
1919: 		series.Unlock()
1920: 	}
1921: 	a.head.putAppendBuffer(a.samples)
1922: 	a.head.putExemplarBuffer(a.exemplars)
1923: 	a.head.putHistogramBuffer(a.histograms)
1924: 	a.head.putFloatHistogramBuffer(a.floatHistograms)
1925: 	a.head.putMetadataBuffer(a.metadata)
1926: 	a.samples = nil
1927: 	a.exemplars = nil
1928: 	a.histograms = nil
1929: 	a.metadata = nil
1930: 
1931: 	// Series are created in the head memory regardless of rollback. Thus we have
1932: 	// to log them to the WAL in any case.
1933: 	return a.log()
1934: }

1936: func (a *headAppender) compactIntegerBuckets(buckets []int64, spans []histogram.Span, maxEmptyBuckets int, deltaBuckets bool) ([]int64, []histogram.Span) {
1937: 	if len(buckets) == 0 {
1938: 		a.integerCompactScratch = a.integerCompactScratch[:0]
1939: 		return buckets, spans
1940: 	}
1941: 	if maxEmptyBuckets < 0 {
1942: 		maxEmptyBuckets = 0
1943: 	}
1944: 	nothingToDo := true
1945: 	var current int64
1946: 	for i := 0; i < len(buckets); i++ {
1947: 		if deltaBuckets {
1948: 			current += buckets[i]
1949: 		} else {
1950: 			current = buckets[i]
1951: 		}
1952: 		if current == 0 {
1953: 			nothingToDo = false
1954: 			break
1955: 		}
1956: 	}
1957: 	if nothingToDo {
1958: 		for i := 0; i < len(spans); i++ {
1959: 			if int(spans[i].Offset) <= maxEmptyBuckets || spans[i].Length == 0 {
1960: 				nothingToDo = false
1961: 				break
1962: 			}
1963: 		}
1964: 		if nothingToDo {
1965: 			a.integerCompactScratch = append(a.integerCompactScratch[:0], buckets...)
1966: 			return buckets, spans
1967: 		}
1968: 	}
1969: 
1970: 	var iBucket, iSpan int
1971: 	var posInSpan uint32
1972: 	current = 0
1973: 
1974: 	emptyBucketsHere := func() int {
1975: 		n := 0
1976: 		abs := current
1977: 		for iSpan < len(spans) && uint32(n)+posInSpan < spans[iSpan].Length && abs == 0 {
1978: 			n++
1979: 			if n+iBucket >= len(buckets) {
1980: 				break
1981: 			}
1982: 			if deltaBuckets {
1983: 				abs += buckets[n+iBucket]
1984: 			} else {
1985: 				abs = buckets[n+iBucket]
1986: 			}
1987: 		}
1988: 		return n
1989: 	}
1990: 
1991: 	if len(spans) > 1 {
1992: 		for i, span := range spans[1:] {
1993: 			if span.Offset == 0 {
1994: 				spans[iSpan].Length += span.Length
1995: 				continue
1996: 			}
1997: 			iSpan++
1998: 			if i+1 != iSpan {
1999: 				spans[iSpan] = span
2000: 			}
2001: 		}
2002: 		spans = spans[:iSpan+1]
2003: 		iSpan = 0
2004: 	}
2005: 
2006: 	write := 0
2007: 	for i, span := range spans {
2008: 		if span.Length == 0 {
2009: 			if i+1 < len(spans) {
2010: 				spans[i+1].Offset += span.Offset
2011: 			}
2012: 			continue
2013: 		}
2014: 		if i != write {
2015: 			spans[write] = span
2016: 		}
2017: 		write++
2018: 	}
2019: 	spans = spans[:write]
2020: 	iSpan = 0
2021: 	if len(spans) == 0 {
2022: 		a.integerCompactScratch = append(a.integerCompactScratch[:0], buckets...)
2023: 		return buckets, spans
2024: 	}
2025: 
2026: 	for iBucket < len(buckets) {
2027: 		if deltaBuckets {
2028: 			current += buckets[iBucket]
2029: 		} else {
2030: 			current = buckets[iBucket]
2031: 		}
2032: 		nEmpty := emptyBucketsHere()
2033: 		if nEmpty > 0 {
2034: 			if posInSpan > 0 && nEmpty < int(spans[iSpan].Length-posInSpan) && nEmpty <= maxEmptyBuckets {
2035: 				iBucket += nEmpty
2036: 				if deltaBuckets {
2037: 					current = 0
2038: 				}
2039: 				posInSpan += uint32(nEmpty)
2040: 				continue
2041: 			}
2042: 			if deltaBuckets && iBucket+nEmpty < len(buckets) {
2043: 				current = -buckets[iBucket]
2044: 				buckets[iBucket+nEmpty] += buckets[iBucket]
2045: 			}
2046: 			buckets = append(buckets[:iBucket], buckets[iBucket+nEmpty:]...)
2047: 			if posInSpan == 0 {
2048: 				if nEmpty == int(spans[iSpan].Length) {
2049: 					offset := spans[iSpan].Offset
2050: 					spans = append(spans[:iSpan], spans[iSpan+1:]...)
2051: 					if len(spans) > iSpan {
2052: 						spans[iSpan].Offset += offset + int32(nEmpty)
2053: 					}
2054: 					continue
2055: 				}
2056: 				spans[iSpan].Length -= uint32(nEmpty)
2057: 				spans[iSpan].Offset += int32(nEmpty)
2058: 				continue
2059: 			}
2060: 			newSpan := histogram.Span{
2061: 				Offset: int32(nEmpty),
2062: 				Length: spans[iSpan].Length - posInSpan - uint32(nEmpty),
2063: 			}
2064: 			spans[iSpan].Length = posInSpan
2065: 			iSpan++
2066: 			posInSpan = 0
2067: 			if newSpan.Length == 0 {
2068: 				if iSpan < len(spans) {
2069: 					spans[iSpan].Offset += int32(nEmpty)
2070: 				}
2071: 				continue
2072: 			}
2073: 			spans = append(spans, histogram.Span{})
2074: 			if iSpan+1 < len(spans) {
2075: 				copy(spans[iSpan+1:], spans[iSpan:])
2076: 			}
2077: 			spans[iSpan] = newSpan
2078: 			continue
2079: 		}
2080: 		iBucket++
2081: 		posInSpan++
2082: 		if iSpan < len(spans) && posInSpan >= spans[iSpan].Length {
2083: 			posInSpan = 0
2084: 			iSpan++
2085: 		}
2086: 	}
2087: 	if maxEmptyBuckets == 0 || len(buckets) == 0 || len(spans) == 0 {
2088: 		a.integerCompactScratch = append(a.integerCompactScratch[:0], buckets...)
2089: 		return buckets, spans
2090: 	}
2091: 
2092: 	iBucket = int(spans[0].Length)
2093: 	if iBucket > len(buckets) {
2094: 		iBucket = len(buckets)
2095: 	}
2096: 	if deltaBuckets {
2097: 		current = 0
2098: 		for _, bucket := range buckets[:iBucket] {
2099: 			current += bucket
2100: 		}
2101: 	}
2102: 	iSpan = 1
2103: 	for iSpan < len(spans) {
2104: 		if int(spans[iSpan].Offset) > maxEmptyBuckets {
2105: 			l := int(spans[iSpan].Length)
2106: 			if deltaBuckets {
2107: 				end := iBucket + l
2108: 				if end > len(buckets) {
2109: 					end = len(buckets)
2110: 				}
2111: 				for _, bucket := range buckets[iBucket:end] {
2112: 					current += bucket
2113: 				}
2114: 			}
2115: 			iBucket += l
2116: 			iSpan++
2117: 			continue
2118: 		}
2119: 		offset := int(spans[iSpan].Offset)
2120: 		if offset < 0 {
2121: 			offset = 0
2122: 		}
2123: 		spans[iSpan-1].Length += uint32(offset) + spans[iSpan].Length
2124: 		spans = append(spans[:iSpan], spans[iSpan+1:]...)
